$comment: rehau.com (Access-controlled manufacturer site): REHAU product pages return access denied (403) for every page fetch from this network; AvalAI's page fetch works but its answer cannot be checked against a saved page. The site is never contacted; the search model answers from the web and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). Engines tried on 2026-11-19: direct page fetch, browser and AvalAI page fetch were denied, timed out or blocked (see the trial log); web_search returned data. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
